purpose: Verify a complete application with valid documents is accepted and submitted.
preconditions: Applicant with valid PMS role; submission draft can be created.
action_or_input: Enter title, abstract, detailed description, claims, inventor information and a PDF supporting document under 50 MB that passes malware validation; confirm submission.
expected_result: Application accepted with a unique application ID; status Submitted; document classified by sensitivity; history/audit record created; submission notification triggered.

purpose: Verify incomplete required information keeps the application unsubmitted.
preconditions: Applicant with valid PMS role; draft exists.
action_or_input: Submit application with a required field (e.g. claims) missing.
expected_result: PMS identifies the missing information; application is not accepted, no application ID or Submitted status is assigned.

purpose: Verify a document failing format, size or malware validation is rejected.
preconditions: Applicant with valid PMS role; draft exists in a valid prior state.
action_or_input: Upload a non-PDF document, a PDF of 50 MB or more, and a document flagged as malware.
expected_result: Each invalid document is rejected; the valid prior application state is retained and no invalid submission is accepted.

purpose: Verify the application is not accepted when an external validation dependency is unavailable.
preconditions: Applicant with valid PMS role; external malware-scanning service configured but unavailable.
action_or_input: Submit a complete application with a supporting document requiring malware validation.
expected_result: Application is not treated as successfully accepted; no Submitted status/ID assigned; prior draft state retained.

purpose: Verify Applicant can view current status, progress and history of own application.
preconditions: Applicant owns an application with recorded history.
action_or_input: Applicant opens the application tracking view for their application.
expected_result: Current status/progress and the recorded application history are displayed; no business state or data changes.

purpose: Verify Applicant can navigate among their own applications and history entries.
preconditions: Applicant owns two applications each with history entries.
action_or_input: Applicant navigates from one own application to the other and opens history entries.
expected_result: Each own application's status and history are displayed; no data is modified.

purpose: Verify access to an unauthorized application record is blocked.
preconditions: Application owned by another Applicant exists.
action_or_input: Applicant attempts to open the other Applicant's application.
expected_result: PMS blocks access; no data disclosed or modified.

purpose: Verify Applicant can add inventors with valid ownership shares and agreements.
preconditions: Applicant has access to the application; status permits change.
action_or_input: Add co-inventor information with valid ownership percentages, record required consent and agreement information.
expected_result: Inventor information and ownership validated and stored; consent/agreement recorded; agreement-completion state available; affected parties notified of inventor change.

purpose: Verify Applicant can update the inventor set or ownership shares before filing.
preconditions: Application not yet Filed with existing valid inventor data; access/state rules permit change.
action_or_input: Update ownership shares of existing inventors to new valid percentages.
expected_result: Updated inventor/ownership data is validated and stored; affected parties notified.

purpose: Verify invalid inventor data or ownership percentages are not accepted.
preconditions: Application with existing valid inventor data.
action_or_input: Submit inventor change with invalid ownership percentages (e.g. totals not valid) or invalid inventor information/consent.
expected_result: Change is not committed; prior valid inventor/agreement data remains.

purpose: Verify prior-art search returns ranked results and selected references attach to the application.
preconditions: Applicant or Attorney with valid role; search source available.
action_or_input: Enter search terms/classification, run search, select references and attach them to the application.
expected_result: Ranked results displayed; selected references attached to application; search session logged.

purpose: Verify Actor may refine keywords/classification and repeat the search.
preconditions: Prior search performed.
action_or_input: Refine keywords/classification mapping and run the search again.
expected_result: A new ranked result set is displayed for the refined query and the search session is logged.

purpose: Verify an unavailable external source is not represented as queried.
preconditions: External source unavailable; application has existing attached references.
action_or_input: Run a search requiring the external source.
expected_result: PMS does not represent the external source as successfully queried and records no fabricated results; existing PMS data remains intact.

purpose: Verify Applicant can revise and resubmit an application within the 60-day period.
preconditions: Application status Needs Revision with Director feedback; decision within 60 days.
action_or_input: Applicant edits content addressing feedback, uploads revised document version and submits the revision.
expected_result: Revised version recorded with version control; new review cycle started.

purpose: Verify Applicant may save revisions before final resubmission.
preconditions: Application in Needs Revision within resubmission period.
action_or_input: Applicant saves revision changes without resubmitting.
expected_result: Revisions saved; application remains in revision state; no new review cycle started.

purpose: Verify a late resubmission is rejected and the application expires.
preconditions: Application Rejected/Needs Revision with decision date more than 60 days ago.
action_or_input: Applicant attempts to resubmit.
expected_result: Application status set to Expired; late resubmission not accepted.

purpose: Verify a revision not addressing Director feedback is rejected.
preconditions: Application Needs Revision within 60 days with recorded feedback.
action_or_input: Submit a revision that does not address the recorded Director feedback.
expected_result: Resubmission rejected; prior valid state retained; no new review cycle.

purpose: Verify Applicant can withdraw a withdrawal-eligible pre-filing application.
preconditions: Application not Filed and in a withdrawal-eligible status.
action_or_input: Applicant provides withdrawal reason and confirms withdrawal.
expected_result: Status set to Withdrawn; application removed from active queue; withdrawal history/status change recorded.

purpose: Verify co-inventor consent is recorded when the process requires it.
preconditions: Withdrawal-eligible application with co-inventors; process requires co-inventor consent.
action_or_input: Applicant provides reason, co-inventor consent is recorded, Applicant confirms withdrawal.
expected_result: Co-inventor consent recorded; status Withdrawn; withdrawal history recorded.

purpose: Verify withdrawal is blocked for a non-eligible status.
preconditions: Application status Filed.
action_or_input: Applicant attempts to withdraw.
expected_result: Withdrawal blocked; status remains Filed.

purpose: Verify PCC_ADMIN assigns a Submitted application to an eligible Director.
preconditions: Submitted application; eligible non-inventor Director with matching expertise; PCC_ADMIN authorized.
action_or_input: PCC_ADMIN confirms assignment to the eligible Director.
expected_result: Assignment recorded; status Under Review; Director notified; review deadline initiated.

purpose: Verify configured automatic routing assigns the application using the same rules.
preconditions: Submitted application; automatic routing enabled; eligible Director exists.
action_or_input: Trigger automatic routing.
expected_result: Application assigned to an eligible non-conflicted Director; status Under Review; Director notified; review deadline initiated.

purpose: Verify application stays Submitted when no eligible assignment exists.
preconditions: Submitted application where the only available Director is listed as an inventor.
action_or_input: Attempt assignment.
expected_result: No conflicted assignment committed; status remains Submitted; exceptional case recorded/raised for PCC_ADMIN.

purpose: Verify assigned Director can approve with a justification of at least 50 characters.
preconditions: Application Under Review assigned to non-conflicted Director within 15 business days.
action_or_input: Director submits Approve with a 50+ character justification.
expected_result: Decision and audit trail recorded; application approved and eligible for attorney assignment.

purpose: Verify Reject outcome is recorded and feedback sent to Applicant.
preconditions: Application Under Review assigned to the Director.
action_or_input: Director submits Reject with a 50+ character justification.
expected_result: Rejection recorded with audit trail; detailed feedback sent to Applicant.

purpose: Verify Needs Revision outcome is recorded and feedback sent to Applicant.
preconditions: Application Under Review assigned to the Director.
action_or_input: Director submits Needs Revision with a 50+ character justification.
expected_result: Needs Revision recorded with audit trail; detailed feedback sent to Applicant.

purpose: Verify a decision without required justification is not accepted.
preconditions: Application Under Review assigned to the Director.
action_or_input: Director submits Approve with a justification shorter than 50 characters (or empty).
expected_result: Decision not accepted; application state unchanged.

purpose: Verify a conflicted or unassigned Director cannot submit a decision.
preconditions: Application Under Review assigned to another Director; acting Director is unassigned or listed as inventor.
action_or_input: Acting Director submits a decision with valid justification.
expected_result: Decision rejected; application state unchanged.

purpose: Verify Director approves a within-threshold budget for an Approved application.
preconditions: Application Approved; cost within configured threshold; budget available.
action_or_input: Director reviews filing, attorney and administrative fees and records Budget Approved.
expected_result: Budget approval recorded with financial/authorization metadata; budget notification triggered.

purpose: Verify Director can record Budget Rejected for a within-threshold cost.
preconditions: Application Approved; cost within threshold.
action_or_input: Director records Budget Rejected.
expected_result: Budget rejection recorded with audit metadata; budget notification triggered.

purpose: Verify above-threshold cost is escalated instead of decided.
preconditions: Application Approved; cost exceeds configured threshold.
action_or_input: Request budget review/decision.
expected_result: Case routed/escalated to higher authority; Escalated state recorded; no higher-authority decision invented.

purpose: Verify approval is not recorded when budget-availability validation fails.
preconditions: Application Approved; budget-availability data available and insufficient.
action_or_input: Director attempts to record Budget Approved.
expected_result: Approval not recorded.

purpose: Verify PCC_ADMIN assigns an approved-panel Attorney to an Approved application.
preconditions: Application Approved; panel Attorney without conflict; PCC_ADMIN authorized.
action_or_input: PCC_ADMIN selects and records the panel Attorney.
expected_result: Assignment recorded; Attorney notified for acceptance/decline.

purpose: Verify Applicant-preferred Attorney is considered only when in the approved panel.
preconditions: Application Approved; Applicant prefers one panel Attorney and one non-panel Attorney (no exception).
action_or_input: Assign the preferred panel Attorney; attempt to assign the preferred non-panel Attorney.
expected_result: Panel preferred Attorney assignment recorded; non-panel preferred Attorney blocked.

purpose: Verify a recorded institutional exception permits a non-panel Attorney.
preconditions: Application Approved; recorded institutional exception for a non-panel Attorney.
action_or_input: PCC_ADMIN assigns the non-panel Attorney.
expected_result: Assignment recorded; Attorney notified.

purpose: Verify assignment is not recorded when conflict-of-interest constraint fails.
preconditions: Application Approved; selected Attorney has conflict of interest.
action_or_input: PCC_ADMIN attempts assignment.
expected_result: Assignment not recorded.

purpose: Verify Attorney acceptance sets Attorney Assigned.
preconditions: Active assignment exists for the Attorney.
action_or_input: Attorney chooses Accept.
expected_result: Response recorded; assignment accepted and status Attorney Assigned.

purpose: Verify Attorney decline records Pending Review and notifies PCC_ADMIN.
preconditions: Active assignment exists for the Attorney.
action_or_input: Attorney chooses Decline.
expected_result: Response recorded; status Pending Review; PCC_ADMIN notified.

purpose: Verify response without an active assignment is not accepted.
preconditions: Attorney has no active assignment for the application.
action_or_input: Attorney submits Accept.
expected_result: Response not accepted; no assignment changed.

purpose: Verify Attorney records patentability opinion with a supported recommendation.
preconditions: Attorney assigned to the application with access.
action_or_input: Record novelty, non-obviousness and utility evaluation, detailed opinion and recommendation File Patent.
expected_result: Opinion and recommendation recorded; relevant stakeholders notified.

purpose: Verify Attorney may request additional information or extension.
preconditions: Attorney assigned; process supports the request.
action_or_input: Attorney submits a request for additional information/extension.
expected_result: Request recorded.

purpose: Verify opinion without a supported recommendation is not finalized.
preconditions: Attorney assigned; prior legal-review record exists.
action_or_input: Submit opinion with no recommendation or an unsupported value.
expected_result: Opinion not finalized; prior valid legal-review record remains.

purpose: Verify national filing is recorded and status set to Filed.
preconditions: Approvals and budget complete; inventor agreements complete; Attorney has filing authority.
action_or_input: Prepare package, record Indian Patent Office filing ID, filing date and confirmation.
expected_result: Filing details recorded; status Filed; audit/history recorded; filing confirmation triggered.

purpose: Verify international filing requires additional justification.
preconditions: All filing prerequisites complete.
action_or_input: Record international filing first without justification, then with justification plus filing ID, date, confirmation.
expected_result: Without justification filing is not recorded; with justification filing recorded and status Filed.

purpose: Verify filing is blocked when a prerequisite is missing.
preconditions: Inventor agreements incomplete (or budget approval missing).
action_or_input: Attempt to record filing.
expected_result: Filing blocked; status not Filed.

purpose: Verify filing is not recorded as Filed without external confirmation.
preconditions: All prerequisites complete.
action_or_input: Attempt to record filing without filing ID/confirmation.
expected_result: Status not set to Filed; no false filing success recorded.

purpose: Verify recording an office action logs it and creates office-action tracking.
preconditions: Filed application; Attorney has access.
action_or_input: Record communication of type office action with date, details and document identifier.
expected_result: Communication logged; office-action tracking created; office-action notification triggered.

purpose: Verify non-office-action communication is recorded without response path.
preconditions: Filed application; Attorney has access.
action_or_input: Record a non-office-action official communication.
expected_result: Communication logged; no office-action tracking/response path initiated.

purpose: Verify invalid/unrelated communication data is not attached to another application.
preconditions: Two applications exist.
action_or_input: Record communication with invalid or mismatched application reference.
expected_result: Communication not attached to the other application; its state unchanged.

purpose: Verify response submission when Applicant review is required and approved.
preconditions: Office action exists requiring Applicant review; Attorney has access.
action_or_input: Attorney prepares draft; Applicant approval recorded; Attorney finalizes and records external submission.
expected_result: Draft initially awaiting Applicant approval; after approval, submission recorded; response tracking and audit updated.

purpose: Verify Attorney can record an extension request when permitted.
preconditions: Office action exists; process permits extension.
action_or_input: Attorney records extension request.
expected_result: Extension status recorded.

purpose: Verify response cannot be marked submitted without required Applicant approval.
preconditions: Office action requiring Applicant review; draft awaiting approval.
action_or_input: Attorney attempts to mark response submitted.
expected_result: Response not marked submitted.

purpose: Verify missed response deadline is handled by escalation rules without legal outcome.
preconditions: Office-action response deadline passed without submission.
action_or_input: Run deadline processing / view response.
expected_result: Deadline handled by escalation rules; no legal outcome recorded.

purpose: Verify PCC_ADMIN views calculated deadlines and alerts and handles a delayed item.
preconditions: Applications with review deadlines at 30, 15 and 5 days; PCC_ADMIN authorized.
action_or_input: PCC_ADMIN opens deadline monitoring and routes a delayed item.
expected_result: Deadlines and 30/15/5-day alerts/notifications shown; handling recorded; deadline-tracking activity logged.

purpose: Verify no deadline is fabricated when rules/data are unavailable.
preconditions: Item lacking applicable deadline rules/data.
action_or_input: Open deadline monitoring.
expected_result: No deadline date fabricated; item flagged as requiring data/configuration.

purpose: Verify missed deadline is escalated per configured chain.
preconditions: Missed deadline; escalation chain configured.
action_or_input: Process/view the missed deadline.
expected_result: Escalation record created per configured chain; no legal consequence inferred.

purpose: Verify Renew decision leads to recorded maintenance action and next cycle.
preconditions: Patent Granted; schedule rules available.
action_or_input: Attorney requests renewal decision; Director records Renew; Attorney records maintenance action.
expected_result: Maintenance schedule calculated; maintenance action and renewal history recorded; next cycle scheduled.

purpose: Verify Do Not Renew results in no approved maintenance action.
preconditions: Patent Granted in post-grant tracking.
action_or_input: Director records Do Not Renew; Attorney attempts to record maintenance action as approved.
expected_result: No renewal maintenance action recorded as approved.

purpose: Verify no maintenance schedule is fabricated without rules/data.
preconditions: Patent Granted; schedule rules unavailable for jurisdiction.
action_or_input: Activate post-grant tracking.
expected_result: No maintenance schedule fabricated.

purpose: Verify Director records Renew decision.
preconditions: Patent Granted in post-grant tracking; decision due.
action_or_input: Director chooses Renew.
expected_result: Renew decision recorded and available to Attorney.

purpose: Verify Director records Do Not Renew decision.
preconditions: Patent Granted in post-grant tracking; decision due.
action_or_input: Director chooses Do Not Renew.
expected_result: Do Not Renew decision recorded.

purpose: Verify renewal decision rejected for non-Granted patent.
preconditions: Application not Granted (e.g. Filed).
action_or_input: Director submits Renew.
expected_result: Decision not accepted; nothing recorded.

purpose: Verify document upload creates next version and archives previous.
preconditions: Authorized user; status permits upload; document version 1 exists.
action_or_input: Upload new document version.
expected_result: Version 2 assigned; version 1 archived and accessible to authorized users; user and timestamp recorded.

purpose: Verify Applicant can edit documents only in Needs Revision status.
preconditions: Applicant's applications in Needs Revision and Under Review.
action_or_input: Upload new version for each application.
expected_result: Upload accepted for Needs Revision; blocked for Under Review.

purpose: Verify other roles upload/access versions only where permitted.
preconditions: Attorney role with/without role-status permission for the application.
action_or_input: Attorney accesses/uploads version in permitted and non-permitted contexts.
expected_result: Permitted action succeeds; non-permitted action blocked.

purpose: Verify unauthorized upload/access is blocked and logged.
preconditions: User without permission for the application.
action_or_input: Attempt upload and previous-version access.
expected_result: Blocked; no version created or disclosed; attempt logged.

purpose: Verify licensing request is submitted and routed.
preconditions: Applicant has access to the patent record; routing target configured.
action_or_input: Submit licensing request with required information.
expected_result: Request submitted and routed to configured committee/Director; routing/tracking state recorded.

purpose: Verify technology-transfer request uses same submission goal.
preconditions: Applicant has access to the patent record.
action_or_input: Submit technology-transfer type request.
expected_result: Request recorded with technology-transfer type, routed and tracked.

purpose: Verify no committee decision is invented when routing target undetermined.
preconditions: No routing target configured.
action_or_input: Submit request.
expected_result: No committee decision/review outcome recorded.

purpose: Verify Director records negotiation information and final agreement for routed request.
preconditions: Request routed to Director.
action_or_input: Director reviews request; negotiation info and final agreement recorded.
expected_result: Negotiation and agreement recorded; license record maintained with confidentiality controls.

purpose: Verify committee-routed request allows PMS to record resulting information.
preconditions: Request routed to a committee.
action_or_input: Authorized user records committee-provided resulting information.
expected_result: Information recorded; no PMS actor decision invented.

purpose: Verify PMS does not record unstated approval/rejection semantics.
preconditions: Request routed to Director.
action_or_input: Attempt to record an approve/reject decision on the request.
expected_result: No approval/rejection outcome recorded.

purpose: Verify eligible appeal against rejection is recorded.
preconditions: Application Rejected within appeal period.
action_or_input: Applicant submits grounds and justification.
expected_result: Appeal recorded as submitted for Director review.

purpose: Verify appeal for non-Rejected application or outside period is not accepted.
preconditions: Application Approved; another Rejected with appeal period expired.
action_or_input: Submit appeal for each.
expected_result: Both appeals not accepted; states unchanged.

purpose: Verify Director records Uphold Rejection outcome.
preconditions: Submitted appeal available to Director.
action_or_input: Director selects Uphold Rejection.
expected_result: Outcome recorded; next applicable step initiated.

purpose: Verify Director records Remand for Amendment outcome.
preconditions: Submitted appeal available to Director.
action_or_input: Director selects Remand for Amendment.
expected_result: Outcome recorded; next applicable step initiated.

purpose: Verify Director records Modify Decision outcome.
preconditions: Submitted appeal available to Director.
action_or_input: Director selects Modify Decision.
expected_result: Outcome recorded.

purpose: Verify unsupported appeal outcome is rejected.
preconditions: Submitted appeal available to Director.
action_or_input: Director submits an unsupported outcome value.
expected_result: Outcome not accepted; nothing recorded.

purpose: Verify PCC_ADMIN generates a system-wide report and access is logged.
preconditions: PCC_ADMIN active; recorded PMS data.
action_or_input: Generate application status report with filters and export.
expected_result: Report generated from recorded data; report access logged; no business state change.

purpose: Verify available report types can be generated.
preconditions: PCC_ADMIN active.
action_or_input: Generate financial/budget, deadline, inventor, portfolio and workload reports.
expected_result: Each report type generated.

purpose: Verify unauthorized or unavailable data is not included or fabricated.
preconditions: Non-PCC_ADMIN user; or report with no data.
action_or_input: Request system-wide report.
expected_result: Unauthorized data excluded/access blocked; no fabricated data.

purpose: Verify PCC_ADMIN updates PMS role mapping and change is audited.
preconditions: Exactly one active PCC_ADMIN.
action_or_input: Assign Director role to a user.
expected_result: Role mapping updated; change recorded in audit.

purpose: Verify PCC_ADMIN can set configurable values (e.g. threshold).
preconditions: Exactly one active PCC_ADMIN.
action_or_input: Update budget escalation threshold configuration.
expected_result: Configuration value stored and audited.

purpose: Verify platform/HR data is not changed and single-PCC_ADMIN rule enforced.
preconditions: Exactly one active PCC_ADMIN.
action_or_input: Attempt to add a second active PCC_ADMIN through PMS administration.
expected_result: Change rejected; no platform account/HR data changed.

purpose: Verify PCC_ADMIN maintains attorney panel and expertise mapping.
preconditions: PCC_ADMIN authorized.
action_or_input: Add Attorney to approved panel with expertise mapping.
expected_result: Panel/expertise data recorded and used by assignment validation.

purpose: Verify institutional exception is recorded separately for non-panel assignment.
preconditions: PCC_ADMIN authorized; non-panel Attorney.
action_or_input: Record institutional exception for the Attorney.
expected_result: Exception recorded separately; Attorney not added to the panel.

purpose: Verify unauthorized panel change is not committed.
preconditions: Non-PCC_ADMIN user.
action_or_input: Attempt to modify panel.
expected_result: Change not committed.

purpose: Verify PCC_ADMIN handles exceptional case and handling is recorded.
preconditions: Exceptional case exists (no eligible assignee).
action_or_input: PCC_ADMIN routes the case to the applicable authority.
expected_result: Handling/routing action and tracking state recorded.

purpose: Verify conflict-of-interest and delayed-action escalations are visible and handled.
preconditions: Conflict-of-interest case and delayed-action escalation exist.
action_or_input: PCC_ADMIN reviews and resolves/routes each.
expected_result: Each case listed; handling recorded.

purpose: Verify PCC_ADMIN cannot record unstated external decisions.
preconditions: Escalated budget case awaiting higher authority.
action_or_input: PCC_ADMIN attempts to record higher-authority budget decision.
expected_result: Decision not recorded; case remains routed/escalated.

purpose: Verify PCC_ADMIN views audit records with required fields.
preconditions: Audit records exist for an application.
action_or_input: Select application scope and view audit logs.
expected_result: Records shown with user ID, action type, timestamp, application ID, previous and new state; no audit data altered.

purpose: Verify Director audit access is limited to authorized domain.
preconditions: Director with domain; audit records inside and outside domain.
action_or_input: Director views audit logs.
expected_result: Only in-domain records shown.

purpose: Verify unauthorized audit access is blocked.
preconditions: Applicant user.
action_or_input: Attempt to open audit logs.
expected_result: Access blocked.

purpose: Verify Applicant approval of draft response is recorded.
preconditions: Process requires Applicant review; draft response exists.
action_or_input: Applicant reviews and approves draft.
expected_result: Approval recorded; Attorney can finalize/submit.

purpose: Verify response can be finalized without Applicant review when not required.
preconditions: Office action where Applicant review is not required.
action_or_input: Attorney finalizes and records submission without Applicant approval.
expected_result: Submission recorded; no Applicant approval step needed.

purpose: Verify response without recorded approval is not treated as approved.
preconditions: Process requires Applicant review; draft awaiting approval.
action_or_input: Query approval state / attempt finalize without approval.
expected_result: Response not shown as Applicant-approved; finalization blocked.

purpose: Verify Applicant report contains only own applications.
preconditions: Applicant with own applications; other Applicants' applications exist.
action_or_input: Open personal application report.
expected_result: Report displays only the Applicant's own applications.

purpose: Verify export option provided only where supported.
preconditions: Applicant with own applications; report supports export.
action_or_input: Export personal report.
expected_result: Export contains only own application data.

purpose: Verify access to another Applicant's report data is blocked.
preconditions: Another Applicant's application exists.
action_or_input: Request report data for the other Applicant.
expected_result: Access blocked.

purpose: Verify Director generates in-scope report and access is logged.
preconditions: Director with authorized role and domain.
action_or_input: Open report/analytics view.
expected_result: Report generated within Director scope; access logged.

purpose: Verify authorized Director can export a report.
preconditions: Director authorized for export.
action_or_input: Export report.
expected_result: Export produced within authorized scope.

purpose: Verify unauthorized report scope is blocked.
preconditions: Director.
action_or_input: Request report scope outside Director domain.
expected_result: Request blocked.

purpose: Verify Director views domain workflow oversight.
preconditions: Director with domain; applications in domain.
action_or_input: Open workflow oversight view.
expected_result: Workflow states and pending actions within domain displayed; no state changes.

purpose: Verify out-of-domain information is not disclosed.
preconditions: Applications outside Director domain exist.
action_or_input: Open oversight / request out-of-domain application.
expected_result: Out-of-domain applications not disclosed.

purpose: Verify Attorney records legal advice associated with application.
preconditions: Attorney with access to application.
action_or_input: Record legal advice note.
expected_result: Advice stored and associated with application history/audit.

purpose: Verify legal advice recording does not change application status at any stage.
preconditions: Applications in different lifecycle stages (e.g. Approved, Filed).
action_or_input: Record legal advice on each.
expected_result: Advice recorded; application statuses unchanged.

purpose: Verify unauthorized access or invalid reference prevents storage.
preconditions: Attorney without access; non-existent application ID.
action_or_input: Attempt to record advice.
expected_result: Record not stored; no application state changed.
